requirements.rule: Absences are deducted at 1/175 an hour, a day taken as 8 hours whatever the company schedule.
requirements.remediation: Take the company daily schedule for the hours of an absent day.

requirements.rule: APPRENTICESHIP (stesura 22/9/2012, art. 3 A, CNEL n. 468 pp. 16 and 22, unchanged by the later renewals): the contract of 6 months to 3 years is split in two halves; in the first the apprentice is one category below the destination, in the second at the destination, both paid the minimo contrattuale without IPO (nor EAR or EDR). The engine counts levels, not categories, pays the whole base_salary of a level and splits at fixed months, so no track is modelled and an apprentice run fails closed (no track).
requirements.remediation: Model an under-classification by category paid at the minimo without IPO, with periods of half the contract duration.

requirements.rule: The engine computes the rate of the separate taxation of arrears from PriorYearTaxFacts.net_income_biennio (art. 21 cc. 1, 3 TUIR) and reduces the tax by ArrearsEvent.unused_deductions, the deductions of artt. 12 and 13 cc. 1-2 the worker did not use in the years the arrears refer to (art. 21 c. 4). An arrears event that does not state them, among which the una tantum the engine pays itself, is taxed without the reduction, so the tax may be overstated.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.variable_pay.arrears.handlers._handle_arrears; art. 21 TUIR (Normattiva, text in force from 31-12-2024 to 31-12-2026, page sha256 9638f2c5aec6e3615193a672b6d07c3cd31083640b1c890b73022aa9951745f1)
requirements.remediation: State ArrearsEvent.unused_deductions from the worker's declaration of the deductions used each year; for the una tantum, carry it into the events the engine generates.

requirements.rule: Art. 12: the Easter quota of 1/25 is of the 'retribuzione globale di fatto'; the engine pays it, as the holidays on a Sunday of art. 20, on the monthly pay of art. 15 point 1 (minimo, IPO, scatti, individual elements), without the other recurring allowances of the global pay (shift and similar).
requirements.remediation: Compute the Easter quota on the retribuzione globale di fatto (the recurring allowances of the month included).

requirements.rule: The EDR is paid whatever the absences of the month and has no effect on other institutes, while the engine reduces it with the month and counts it in the sickness quota.
requirements.remediation: Keep the EDR whole in partial months and out of the sickness quota.

requirements.rule: Art. 9 point 1: the 5% premium from 37h45 to 40 weekly hours is resolved when OvertimeEvent.weekly_hours_before is supplied. The hourly event base includes the Art. 15(1) elements; the underlying hours may instead receive compensatory rest under Art. 8 E(2). Pluriperiodal calendar hours offset elsewhere are excluded under Art. 8 E(4); noncollective additional hours in that schedule have a separate 10% premium under Art. 9 clarification 3. Without the worker's schedule and compensatory-rest arrangement, those cases are not determined.
requirements.remediation: Supply the weekly position and separately account for pluriperiodal scheduling and the underlying pay/rest arrangement.

requirements.rule: INSURED ABSENCES: compulsory maternity leave (top-up to 100% of the gross retribuzione globale di fatto for five months, Art. 41) and work injury (full net pay with the INAIL indemnity advanced, Art. 40 C) as work_rules.insured_absence. The full pay of an injury lasts three, four or five months by seniority and halves after: the engine tops up every injury day to 100%.
requirements.remediation: Count the injury days against the full-pay and half-pay periods of Art. 40 C, with the sickness of the same window.

requirements.rule: Renewal of 2025, p. 47: the night-shift indemnity in cifra, outside the TFR base (EUR 13.50 per 8 hours, EUR 15.50 from 1/7/2027).
requirements.remediation: Model the night-shift indemnity per shift.

requirements.rule: Art. 9 punti 9 and 11: the premiums of pluriperiodale work (10% beyond the 8th hour and on Saturday) and of the first 120 hours past the 2,024 of a year (30%), which the engine has no work for. The Saturday of a 4- or 6-day week (point 10, 10%) is modelled (CHIM_SABATO, HolidayWorkKind.SATURDAY_SIXTH_DAY); holiday, night, shift and 3x7 Sunday premiums are modelled.
requirements.remediation: Model the pluriperiodale, Saturday and annual-excess premiums of Art. 9 punti 9-11.

requirements.rule: Scope: the tables of the Fibre, Abrasivi, Lubrificanti e GPL and Ceramica sectors differ and are not modelled.
requirements.remediation: Add the tables of the other sectors.

requirements.rule: A parental leave by the hour takes half the average daily hours a day and counts two such days as one day of leave, the general criterion of art. 32 c. 1-ter D.Lgs. 151/2001 (INPS circ. 152/2015 par. 2.2); a collective agreement, also of the company, that sets other hours to a day of leave or other rules of cumulation prevails, and the bundle holds none.
requirements.remediation: Source the collective rules on the leave by the hour of the CCNL (hours of a day of leave, cumulation) and apply them, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: Artt. 48-50: the premio di partecipazione, the premio variabile and the elemento perequativo.
requirements.remediation: Model the premi of Artt. 48-50 with the employer facts they need.

requirements.rule: LEAVE, ROL OF THE TURNISTI (Art. 13 A): the turnisti 3x5 and 3x6 have 76 hours in the 2006 text (a secondary source states 88 under the current text, not verified on a primary text), the turnisti on a continuous cycle have no hour bucket (232.5 days a year) and the semicontinui on night shift 2 more rest days. The shift pattern is not an input: the engine accrues the 68 hours of the giornalieri and the turnisti 2x5 and 2x6.
requirements.remediation: Source the current hours of the turnisti 3x5 and 3x6 and add the shift pattern as an employment fact.

requirements.rule: Sickness: the scales of fixed-term contracts and apprentices (75/60/45/30 days in full, as many at half), the comporto 30% longer for disabled workers (L. 68/1999), the therapies of oncological and degenerative illnesses outside the comporto, the restart of an exhausted treatment on a hospital stay of more than 10 days; hospital stays are left out of the comporto over the whole window, the CCNL does it within one continuous event.
requirements.remediation: Model the fixed-term and apprentice scales and the comporto rules of the sickness article.

requirements.rule: L. 260/1949 art. 5 pays the workers with a fixed salary a further daily quota only for the civil holidays (25 April, 1 May, 2 June) falling on a Sunday; the other holidays of art. 2 (1 January, 6 January, Easter Monday, 15 August, 4 October, 1 November, 8 December, 25 and 26 December) give it only by CCNL clause, and the payment of 4 November is a CCNL institute. A run of a month with such a holiday on a Sunday, in a CCNL whose clause is not sourced (work_rules.sunday_holidays), pays the statutory holidays only; a public employment is paid none, its treatment not being sourced.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.sunday_holiday.services.sunday_holiday; L. 260/1949 artt. 2 and 5 (Normattiva, art. 2 page sha256 42631c3dd629fe3a1c5e10efc7e3b7b86bb5a2b5325024aa4105eaadfcb49828, art. 5 page sha256 dbd670c663744af9); L. 54/1977 art. 1 (page sha256 cde3b9773f4411d28334a85bebdf9358fc4c161d745772df70f38bc79f48d09e)
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on the holidays falling on a Sunday and record it as work_rules.sunday_holidays.

requirements.rule: The una tantum of a renewal is paid from the CCNL data with readings no text read settles in full: a month of service in the covered period counts with the days of the una tantum (15 when the text is silent), over the months of the period; the absences of a month do not reduce it, though a text may pay the months 'di effettiva prestazione'; a part time is paid in proportion to its hours; a run without the employment period is paid none; the share of the covered months of earlier years is taxed apart as arrears.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.compensation.una_tantum.rules.una_tantum_events; CCNL agenti immobiliari FIAIP 19 May 2025 art. 163 (pp. 97-98, sha256 560d16410d3e41dc0bfb00bfe2a40ef65f2cd900234aeaee92018ed9fa21ead5)
requirements.remediation: Source the counting of the months, the part time and the taxation of each una tantum from its agreement, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: Renewal of 2025, p. 45: the una tantum contribution of EUR 25 withheld in July 2025 from non-member workers.
requirements.remediation: Model the withholding of July 2025 for non-member workers.
